name: RunningSum
description: Running sum over a window. Calculates a running sum over the last N samples.

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Input signal

inputs.name: numsamp
inputs.description: Number of samples in the running sum window

name: RunningMin
description: Running minimum over a window. Tracks the minimum value over the last N samples.

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Input signal

inputs.name: numsamp
inputs.description: Number of samples in the window

name: RunningMax
description: Running maximum over a window. Tracks the maximum value over the last N samples.

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Input signal

inputs.name: numsamp
inputs.description: Number of samples in the window

name: PeakFollower
description: Peak tracking envelope follower. Follows the peak amplitude of a signal.

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Input signal

inputs.name: decay
inputs.description: Decay coefficient per sample (0 to 1). Values close to 1 = slower decay

name: ZeroCrossing
description: Zero crossing frequency. Estimates frequency by counting zero crossings.

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Input signal

name: Pitch
description: Pitch tracking and analysis. Autocorrelation-based pitch detector.

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Input signal to analyze

inputs.name: initFreq
inputs.description: Initial frequency guess in Hz

inputs.name: minFreq
inputs.description: Minimum frequency to detect in Hz

inputs.name: maxFreq
inputs.description: Maximum frequency to detect in Hz

inputs.name: execFreq
inputs.description: Analysis rate in Hz

inputs.name: maxBinsPerOctave
inputs.description: Granularity of pitch detection

inputs.name: median
inputs.description: Median filter length (0=no filter)

inputs.name: ampThreshold
inputs.description: Amplitude threshold below which frequency = 0

inputs.name: peakThreshold
inputs.description: Peak threshold for autocorrelation (0 to 1)

inputs.name: downSample
inputs.description: Downsampling factor

name: BeatTrack
description: Autocorrelation-based beat tracker. Outputs ticks at quarter, eighth, sixteenth note level plus current detected tempo. Expects FFT size 1024 at 44.1/48kHz or 2048 at 88.2/96kHz; uses a ~6 second analysis window biased toward 100-120 bpm.

inputs.name: chain
inputs.description: FFT chain (e.g. from FFT UGen). Required FFT size: 1024 for 44.1/48kHz, 2048 for 88.2/96kHz

inputs.name: lock
inputs.description: If > 0.5, lock the tracker to current periodicity and phase. Set back to 0 to resume tracking

name: BeatTrack2
description: Template-matching beat tracker. Cross-correlates feature streams from a control bus against straight and swung 16th-note templates over tempi 60-180 bpm. Outputs beat tick, eighth tick, groove tick, tempo, phase, and groove. ~2.5-2.8s latency.

inputs.name: busindex
inputs.description: Control bus index from which to read consecutive feature streams

inputs.name: numfeatures
inputs.description: Number of features (consecutive control buses) to read

inputs.name: windowsize
inputs.description: Temporal window in seconds (2.0-3.0 models human window). Larger = more stable but less reactive

inputs.name: phaseaccuracy
inputs.description: Phase test spacing in seconds. Smaller = more phase tests = higher CPU

inputs.name: lock
inputs.description: If > 0.5, lock to current periodicity/phase. Set back to 0 to resume tracking

inputs.name: weightingscheme
inputs.description: Tempo weighting: -2.5 = flat, -1.5 = event-count compensation, or buffer number with 120 weights (60-179 bpm)

name: KeyTrack
description: 12TET major/minor key tracker. Builds a pitch class profile from FFT bins and matches against major/minor scale templates in all transpositions (440Hz reference). Output 0-11 = C-B major, 12-23 = C-B minor. Requires 4096 FFT (44.1/48kHz) or 8192 (88.2/96kHz).

inputs.name: chain
inputs.description: FFT chain. Required FFT size: 4096 for 44.1/48kHz, 8192 for 88.2/96kHz

inputs.name: keydecay
inputs.description: Seconds for a window's influence on the final key decision to decay by 40dB

inputs.name: chromaleak
inputs.description: Per-frame chroma multiplier (0.0 = no memory between frames)

name: MFCC
description: Mel-frequency cepstral coefficients. Computes Mel-scale band energies (42 bands, triangular crossfade), then a DCT to produce a small set of timbral descriptors. Output values approximately in 0.0-1.0 range; first coefficient is typically highest.

inputs.name: chain
inputs.description: FFT chain. Typical FFT size: 1024 (44.1/48kHz) or 2048 (88.2/96kHz)

inputs.name: numcoeff
inputs.description: Number of coefficients to output (max 42). The 0th is omitted; use as few as practical

name: Loudness
description: Perceptual loudness in sones. Sums excitation in ERB bands with simple spectral and temporal masking, applies equal-loudness contour correction (phons), then phon-to-sone transform. Typical output range 0-64 sones.

inputs.name: chain
inputs.description: FFT chain. Typical FFT size: 1024 (44.1/48kHz) or 2048 (88.2/96kHz)

inputs.name: smask
inputs.description: Spectral masking: per-bin power falloff multiplier for lower bins masking higher bins within ERB bands

inputs.name: tmask
inputs.description: Temporal masking in phons: previous-frame phon level minus tmask competes against new measurement (max wins)

name: Onsets
description: Onset detector for musical audio (note/drumbeat starts). Outputs a control-rate trigger (1 on detection, 0 otherwise). Multiple ODF (onset detection function) types available; default rcomplex performs well across material.

inputs.name: chain
inputs.description: FFT chain. Typical FFT size: 512 or 1024 at 44.1kHz (10-20ms span)

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.description: Detection threshold, typically 0-1 (occasionally outside this range)

inputs.name: odftype
inputs.description: Onset detection function: 0=power, 1=magsum, 2=complex, 3=rcomplex (default), 4=phase, 5=wphase, 6=mkl

inputs.name: relaxtime
inputs.description: Whitening relaxation time in seconds — how long until the normalisation 'forgets' a recent onset (unused for mkl)

inputs.name: floor
inputs.description: Whitening lower limit. Lower (e.g. 1e-6) for clean classical material with wide dynamics (unused for mkl)

inputs.name: mingap
inputs.description: Minimum gap in FFT frames between detections (brute-force double-trigger guard)

inputs.name: medianspan
inputs.description: Median window size in FFT frames for smoothing the detection function

inputs.name: whtype
inputs.description: Whitening type

inputs.name: rawodf
inputs.description: If 1, output the raw onset detection function value instead of a trigger

name: SpecCentroid
description: Spectral centroid (weighted mean frequency / 'centre of mass' of the spectrum, ignoring DC). Useful indicator of perceptual brightness.

inputs.name: buffer
inputs.description: FFT chain

name: SpecFlatness
description: Spectral flatness measure: power spectrum geometric mean divided by arithmetic mean. Approximately 0 for a pure sinusoid, approximately 1 for white noise. Linear scale.

inputs.name: buffer
inputs.description: FFT chain

name: SpecPcile
description: Frequency value at a given percentile of the cumulative magnitude spectrum. The 90th or 95th percentile is commonly used as a spectral roll-off measure.

inputs.name: buffer
inputs.description: FFT chain

inputs.name: fraction
inputs.description: Percentile fraction (0-1). 0.9 returns the frequency below which 90% of spectral energy lies

inputs.name: interpolate
inputs.description: If 1, linearly interpolate the bin number for a more accurate estimate (slightly higher CPU)

inputs.name: binout
inputs.description: If 1, output the bin number instead of the frequency

name: PV_HainsworthFoote
description: FFT onset detector combining the Hainsworth metric (KL-distance-based) and the Foote metric. Spots spectral change so may also catch chord transitions, with risk of FM-induced false positives.

inputs.name: buffer
inputs.description: FFT chain

inputs.name: proph
inputs.description: Strength of the Hainsworth metric component

inputs.name: propf
inputs.description: Strength of the Foote metric component (Foote is normalised to 0-1)

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.description: Detection threshold

inputs.name: waittime
inputs.description: Minimum wait in seconds before another detection can fire

name: PV_JensenAndersen
description: FFT feature-based onset detector using first-order derivatives of spectral centroid, high-frequency energy, high-frequency content, and spectral flux features. Threshold may need to be set low to catch changes.

inputs.name: buffer
inputs.description: FFT chain

inputs.name: propsc
inputs.description: Proportion of the spectral centroid feature

inputs.name: prophfe
inputs.description: Proportion of the high-frequency energy feature

inputs.name: prophfc
inputs.description: Proportion of the high-frequency content feature

inputs.name: propsf
inputs.description: Proportion of the spectral flux feature

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.description: Detection threshold

inputs.name: waittime
inputs.description: Minimum wait in seconds before another detection can fire
